  SELECT generate_series(date '2017-02-01', date '2017-12-01', interval '1 month')::date AS month_start
), monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.purchased_at)::date AS month_start,
         SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM olist.orders o
  JOIN olist.order_items oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.purchased_at >= timestamp '2017-01-01'
    AND o.purchased_at < timestamp '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), series AS (
  SELECT m.month_start,
         COALESCE(r.revenue, 0) AS revenue
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_revenue r USING (month_start)
)

       , 2) AS variacao_percentual
